headlines.text: Looking back to 2021, when Junior Dos Santos made a statement, debuting in the main event, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.66.
2025 brought us this moment: Jurassic Express & Omega made their first appearance under the AEW banner as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.34 ? a solid showing.
On this day in 2025, Brodido & Briscoe announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.64.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2021, when CM Punk vs. Matt Sydal locked horns for the first time, getting things started right out of the gate on Rampage, rated 7.42 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
Turning the clock back to 2025: Garcia & Yuta arrived in AEW as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.33.

Back on this day in 2025, The Opps (Hobbs, Joe & Shibata) vs. LFI (Dralistico, Mortos & Rush) clashed for the AEW World Trios Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.14. It was the first title opportunity of LFI (Dralistico, Mortos & Rush)'s career.
